subject.title: Successful OpenAI responses do not clear auth_profile_state cooldown after subscription_limit

question: Should a successful direct completion using the same OpenAI OAuth profile invalidate the Codex subscription reset-time block, or should recovery require a dedicated bounded probe through the interactive quota-bearing route?
rationale: Current docs intentionally honor the advertised reset time, while the report argues that another successful route proves recovery; source evidence alone cannot establish that both requests share the same upstream quota contract.

options.title: Same-route success clears
options.body: Clear subscription-limit state only when success is attributed to the same profile, model, transport, and quota-bearing route.

options.title: Probe before clearing
options.body: Keep direct completions isolated and allow one bounded interactive health probe after a conservative interval to clear the block on success.

options.title: Honor reset time
options.body: Keep the reset-time policy and improve diagnostics plus an explicit operator reset command without automatic early recovery.

recommendation.title: Same-route success clears
recommendation.body: Clear subscription-limit state only when success is attributed to the same profile, model, transport, and quota-bearing route.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent fallback/runtime and OpenAI routing history makes this the strongest available owner for the cross-runtime policy choice.
